halo ce, native on ur iphone. first test build, so its a test build. its janky, its beautiful, its a warthog doing 90 in a parking garage

**install:** download the `.ipa` below, open it in **SideStore** or **AltStore**. free apple id works, refresh it every 7 days. installing over an old build keeps ur maps and saves

**bring ur own copy:** first launch asks for ur halo ce xbox disc image (`.xiso` / `.iso`) or a zip of its maps folder. the app ships none of the games files

what works
- the campaign. the first level plays great, the rest is on u to find out
- controllers (xbox, dualsense, mfi) and on screen touch controls in game
- halo pc / ce / halomd map import, `.map` or `.zip`
- internet play: invite links, the server browser, online games

what doesnt
- lan / system link, ios blocks broadcast on free accounts. use invites
- touch layout editor, gyro aim, phone rumble: not yet
- ipad: untested. apple tv: later

when it breaks send the log: files app → On My iPhone → ChupathingyCE → logs. full readme in the repo
